The app's rules say to avoid complex infrastructure without a real need, and they name five items to keep out of the early phases: PostGIS, IFC, AR, OCR and multi-country support.

ANSWER_PATH: 02_PRODUCT/projects/workspaces/casa3d/app/CONSTITUTION.md
ANSWER: Rule 11: "Fără infrastructură complexă fără nevoie reală (fără PostGIS, IFC, AR, OCR, multi-țară în fazele timpurii)." In English: no complex infrastructure without real need, so no PostGIS, IFC, AR, OCR or multi-country support in the early phases.
